announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.22 — account and quota updates
announcements.summary: Adds device-code sign-in, quota trends, and per-credit resets while improving workspace isolation and refresh reliability.
announcements.content:
1. Sign in with a device code when the OAuth callback is unavailable. Reauthorize an existing account and preview imports before saving.
2. Keep Personal and Business subscription, credit, and quota data separate. Quota refresh retries once after renewing an expired token and respects rate-limit retry times.
3. View official lifetime token totals and local quota trends in account details.
4. Use a specific reset credit, browse reset history, and refresh the two-hour cache on demand. A retry after a timeout keeps the same credit and request.
5. Wakeup checks recognize more response formats and report interrupted streams as failures.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.22 — 账号与配额更新
zh.summary: 新增设备码登录、配额趋势和逐卡兑换，优化工作区隔离与刷新可靠性。
zh.content:
1. OAuth 回调不可用时可用设备码登录。支持重新授权原账号，以及确认导入前的只读预检。
2. 分开显示 Personal 和 Business 的订阅、积分和配额。配额刷新在令牌过期时续期重试一次，并遵守服务端限流重试时间。
3. 账号详情可查看官方累计 Token 和本地配额趋势。
4. 可指定重置卡兑换、查看发放及兑换历史。弹窗缓存两小时，可随时手动刷新。兑换超时后重试会沿用原卡片和请求 ID。
5. 唤醒兼容更多响应格式，断流会记录为失败。

announcements.title: 需要更完整的会话管理？试试 AiDeck
announcements.summary: 如需更完整的会话管理、CLI 启动与多实例调度能力，可以安装 uTools 插件 AiDeck。
announcements.content:
Codex Accounts Manager 专注于 VS Code 内的多账号、配额查看与快速切换。

如果你需要更完整的 AI 开发工作台能力，可以安装 uTools 插件 AiDeck：
1. 更完整的会话管理与会话恢复。
2. 支持 Codex 等 CLI 的启动与调度。
3. 面向 Antigravity、Codex 等环境的统一调度层与多实例管理。

项目地址：https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck

en.title: Need fuller session management? Try AiDeck
en.summary: For richer session management, CLI launch, and multi-instance scheduling, install the AiDeck uTools plugin.
en.content:
Codex Accounts Manager focuses on multi-account management, quota viewing, and quick switching inside VS Code.

For a fuller AI development workspace, install the AiDeck uTools plugin:
1. More complete session management and session recovery.
2. Launching and scheduling Codex and other CLI tools.
3. A unified scheduling layer and multi-instance management for environments such as Antigravity and Codex.

Project: https://github.com/wannanbigpig/aideck
